title: NativeVideoRecorderService
responsibility: Captures native browser frames and maps scripted assertions into bounded admitted silent video.

inputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Directory containing only task-owned native recording cache and diagnostics. Defaults to the resolved .cache/harness/native-video directory.

inputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.lookup.slotKey
inputs.description: Stable unit, clip, viewport and motion-profile identity used for an exclusive recording slot.

inputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.lookup.inputHash
inputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of all source, contract, script, fixture, toolchain and recording inputs supplied by the planner.

inputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.lookup.addressedFlags
inputs.description: Reviewer flag IDs included in the recording cache identity as a sorted unique set; defaults to the unflagged variant.

inputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.record.options
inputs.description: Browser, admitted viewport, original revision, addressed flags, diagnostics and isolated prepare, perform and reset callbacks.

inputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.acknowledge.result
inputs.description: Finalized canonical video, poster and exact native-to-encoded timeline returned by this recorder owner.

inputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.acknowledge.receipt
inputs.description: Caller attachment record identity and matching canonical video and poster hashes; permits deleting only this attempt raw frames.

inputs.name: recordingDirectory.root
inputs.description: Directory containing only task-owned native recording cache and diagnostics. Defaults to the resolved .cache/harness/native-video directory.

inputs.name: recordingDirectory.slotKey
inputs.description: Stable unit, clip, viewport and motion-profile identity used for an exclusive recording slot.

inputs.name: recordingDirectory.inputHash
inputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of all source, contract, script, fixture, toolchain and recording inputs supplied by the planner.

inputs.name: recordingDirectory.addressedFlags
inputs.description: Reviewer flag IDs included in the recording cache identity as a sorted unique set; defaults to the unflagged variant.

inputs.name: cachedRecording.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned recording attempt or finalized cache directory; no browser server is started.

inputs.name: leaseRecording.root
inputs.description: Directory containing only task-owned native recording cache and diagnostics. Defaults to the resolved .cache/harness/native-video directory.

inputs.name: leaseRecording.slotKey
inputs.description: Stable unit, clip, viewport and motion-profile identity used for an exclusive recording slot.

inputs.name: leaseRecording.inputHash
inputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of all source, contract, script, fixture, toolchain and recording inputs supplied by the planner.

inputs.name: leaseRecording.addressedFlags
inputs.description: Reviewer flag IDs included in the recording cache identity as a sorted unique set; defaults to the unflagged variant.

inputs.name: finalizeRecording.lease
inputs.description: Exclusive slot lease with its owned partial directory and immutable final directory.

inputs.name: finalizeRecording.result
inputs.description: Finalized canonical video, poster and exact native-to-encoded timeline returned by this recorder owner.

inputs.name: acknowledgeRecording.result
inputs.description: Finalized canonical video, poster and exact native-to-encoded timeline returned by this recorder owner.

inputs.name: acknowledgeRecording.receipt
inputs.description: Caller attachment record identity and matching canonical video and poster hashes; permits deleting only this attempt raw frames.

inputs.name: captureNativeFrames.options
inputs.description: Browser, admitted viewport, original revision, addressed flags, diagnostics and isolated prepare, perform and reset callbacks.

inputs.name: captureNativeFrames.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned recording attempt or finalized cache directory; no browser server is started.

inputs.name: recordingDeadline.operation
inputs.description: Already-started asynchronous setup, capture or reset operation bounded by a deadline.

inputs.name: recordingDeadline.milliseconds
inputs.description: Maximum elapsed wall time before this operation fails.

inputs.name: recordingDeadline.message
inputs.description: Diagnostic message reported when admission or a timed operation fails.

inputs.name: encodeNativeRecording.options
inputs.description: Browser, admitted viewport, original revision, addressed flags, diagnostics and isolated prepare, perform and reset callbacks.

inputs.name: encodeNativeRecording.capture
inputs.description: Bounded native JPEG frame index, renderer assertion events, discarded marker and measured acquisition end.

inputs.name: encodeNativeRecording.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned recording attempt or finalized cache directory; no browser server is started.

inputs.name: recordingHash.bytes
inputs.description: Buffer or UTF-8 text whose exact bytes are hashed with SHA-256.

inputs.name: recordingFailure.message
inputs.description: Diagnostic message reported when admission or a timed operation fails.

inputs.name: recordingFile.path
inputs.description: Regular non-symlink file whose encoded byte size is admitted before reading.

inputs.name: recordingFile.maximum
inputs.description: Maximum admitted encoded file bytes; empty or oversized files are refused before reading.

inputs.name: recordingChild.program
inputs.description: ffmpeg child executable invoked directly without a shell.

inputs.name: recordingChild.args
inputs.description: Bounded encoding or inspection arguments supplied to the child executable.

inputs.name: recordingChild.cwd
inputs.description: Owned attempt directory resolving the encoder numeric raw frame paths.

inputs.name: recordingViewport.viewport
inputs.description: Fixed even CSS pixel dimensions at DPR 1, at most 1920 per axis and 2073600 total pixels.

inputs.name: recordingFlags.flags
inputs.description: Reviewer flag IDs included in the recording cache identity as a sorted unique set; defaults to the unflagged variant.

inputs.name: nativeFrameWriter.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned recording attempt or finalized cache directory; no browser server is started.

inputs.name: nativeFrameWriter.viewport
inputs.description: Fixed even CSS pixel dimensions at DPR 1, at most 1920 per axis and 2073600 total pixels.

inputs.name: showRecordingMarker.page
inputs.description: Fresh isolated page used for a discarded top-layer synchronization marker.

inputs.name: removeRecordingMarker.page
inputs.description: Fresh isolated page used for a discarded top-layer synchronization marker.

inputs.name: verifyRecordingMarker.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned recording attempt or finalized cache directory; no browser server is started.

inputs.name: verifyRecordingMarker.frame
inputs.description: Acquired JPEG frame whose sampled magenta pixel and native timestamp must match the renderer marker.

inputs.name: verifyRecordingMarker.marker
inputs.description: Shown and removed renderer timestamps and the corresponding acquired native-frame timestamp.

inputs.name: recordingTimeline.options
inputs.description: Browser, admitted viewport, original revision, addressed flags, diagnostics and isolated prepare, perform and reset callbacks.

inputs.name: recordingTimeline.capture
inputs.description: Bounded native JPEG frame index, renderer assertion events, discarded marker and measured acquisition end.

inputs.name: nativeVisit.page
inputs.description: Fresh isolated recording page; the browser clock and animations continue normally through a bounded paint barrier.

inputs.name: nativeVisit.frames
inputs.description: Bounded native acquisition index used to select a painted frame or explicitly labelled held static frame.

inputs.name: nativeVisit.kind
inputs.description: Trigger marker or caller-asserted visible state/edge; state and edge visits wait for paint before script advancement.

inputs.name: nativeVisit.id
inputs.description: Nonempty declared state or transition identity already checked by the recording script.

outputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.run
outputs.description: Stable native-video-recorder capability identifier.

outputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.lookup
outputs.description: Validated finalized cache with original capture provenance, or undefined without opening a context.

outputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.record
outputs.description: Admitted silent MP4 and asserted PNG poster with exact per-frame source mapping; failed raw diagnostics are retained.

outputs.name: NativeVideoRecorderService.acknowledge
outputs.description: Matching attachment receipt persisted and only the finalized attempt raw JPEG directory removed.

outputs.name: recordingDirectory
outputs.description: Hashed slot directory and source input hash, with a separate canonical addressed-flag-set discriminator.

outputs.name: cachedRecording
outputs.description: Finalized cache after encoded-size, media-decode and hash admission, retaining original metadata.

outputs.name: leaseRecording
outputs.description: Exclusive slot lock and bounded owned attempt directory; stale crash locks fail closed for owner inspection.

outputs.name: finalizeRecording
outputs.description: Complete result made visible with an atomic attempt-directory rename.

outputs.name: acknowledgeRecording
outputs.description: Persisted matching receipt and removal of only this finalized attempt raw JPEGs.

outputs.name: captureNativeFrames
outputs.description: Native frames and renderer events from one fresh normal-motion context, closed after reset and diagnostics.

outputs.name: recordingDeadline
outputs.description: Operation result, or rejection when the bounded operation deadline expires.

outputs.name: encodeNativeRecording
outputs.description: H.264 yuv420p fast-start MP4 at 30 fps without audio and a decoded asserted-frame poster.

outputs.name: recordingHash
outputs.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the supplied exact bytes.

outputs.name: recordingFailure
outputs.description: Always throws ExpectedCliError with the supplied recording diagnostic.

outputs.name: recordingFile
outputs.description: Admitted regular-file bytes, read only after the encoded size check.

outputs.name: recordingChild
outputs.description: Successful bounded ffmpeg child stdout; threads and dimensions are constrained by its caller.

outputs.name: recordingViewport
outputs.description: Validation succeeds only for fixed even dimensions within the native recording bounds.

outputs.name: nativeFrameWriter
outputs.description: Bounded disk writer with native frame index, callback append operation and deferred failure check.

outputs.name: showRecordingMarker
outputs.description: Renderer epoch timestamp after the magenta synchronization marker is painted in the discarded lead-in.

outputs.name: removeRecordingMarker
outputs.description: Renderer epoch timestamp when the synchronization marker is removed, after waiting for its repaint.

outputs.name: verifyRecordingMarker
outputs.description: Validation that the acquired marker pixel and native timestamp match the renderer marker interval.

outputs.name: recordingTimeline
outputs.description: Required lead-in and tail interval, original native cadence, exact sampled frame mapping and visible assertion positions.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Recording dimensions, bytes, timing, marker, mapping, media admission, cache integrity, lock ownership or receipt cannot satisfy the declared native recording bounds.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: Owned cache, frame, media or receipt filesystem operations cannot complete.

errors.name: callback rejection
errors.description: The caller prepare, perform, reset or shared browser diagnostics callback rejects; its original failure is preserved.
